title: Alien eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- alien body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='60' rx='22' ry='26' fill='#4CD964'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='60' rx='22' ry='26' fill='none' stroke='#7CFFA0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- alien belly -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='66' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#A8F5C0'/>
  <!-- alien head -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='32' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#4CD964'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='32' rx='18' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#7CFFA0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <line x1='36' y1='18' x2='30' y2='8' stroke='#4CD964' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='7' r='4' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='7' r='4' fill='none' stroke='#FFF3B0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='18' x2='62' y2='8' stroke='#4CD964' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='7' r='4' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='7' r='4' fill='none' stroke='#FFF3B0' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <ellipse cx='39' cy='30' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='30' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='31' r='2.5' fill='#1A1A3A'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='31' r='2.5' fill='#1A1A3A'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 40 Q46 47 54 40' fill='none' stroke='#1A1A3A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <line x1='25' y1='52' x2='16' y2='44' stroke='#4CD964' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='67' y1='52' x2='74' y2='42' stroke='#4CD964' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1='38' y1='84' x2='36' y2='94' stroke='#4CD964' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='84' x2='56' y2='94' stroke='#4CD964' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snack: cookie held in right hand -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='38' r='9' fill='#C98A3B'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='38' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#E8B060' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#7A4A1A'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='37' r='1.5' fill='#7A4A1A'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='41' r='1.5' fill='#7A4A1A'/>
  <!-- bite mark on cookie -->
  <circle cx='83' cy='34' r='4' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <!-- crumbs -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#E8B060'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='50' r='1.2' fill='#E8B060'/>
</svg>
